verdict: People who find you like you (4.6 stars), but too few find you, and the paywall loses most of those who do. Fix the paywall and the first screenshot before you buy more installs.

fixes.title: Move the paywall after the first habit and add a 7-day trial
fixes.why: Users who log one habit before they see a price are more likely to start a trial. This is the biggest leak.

fixes.title: Rebuild screenshots 1–3 around the outcome and real reviews
fixes.why: Most store visitors never scroll past the first screenshots. Today they see a settings screen.

fixes.why: 3 static ads can't find a winner. Competitors run 40–120.
